description: Play Together Production Hardening: Monotonic Revision Sync, Anti-Drift Math, Authentic Buffer State & Auto-Resync.
changelog: Monotonic revision system (revisions 1..N) to prevent out-of-order queue or seek packets from overwriting newer track changes
Authoritative elapsed-time advancement math: guest calculates exact host playback position accounting for network latency
Eliminated fake BUFFER_READY: player reports ready only after ExoPlayer finishes stream extraction and buffering
Added ExoPlayer onPlayerError hook on guest to trigger automatic room resync on extraction failure
Explicit connection state machine (AUTHENTICATING, IN_ROOM, FAILED) with 15s connection handshake watchdog
Standardized structured [LT] logging across WebSocket, Player, Queue, and Drift layers
